messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for model-quality-regression on production: /v1/generate latency normal but failure rate spike + outputs flagged by QA checks. Root TS 2173456789
Alex (oncall): on it. triaging now, attaching console logs.
Alex (oncall): quick note: errors start ~2173456600, affects ~3% of requests, mostly long-context chat routes.
Maya (SRE): looking at replicas. No infra cpu/gpu anomalies, nodes healthy. I'll pull model logs for tokenization/kv-cache failures.
Alex (oncall): found noisy stacktraces: `RuntimeError: kv cache mismatch` repeated + some OOM-ish retries. suspect model variant mismatch on canary.
Lina (Product): is this customer-visible? priority for communications?
Jared (Support): we have 2 active customer alerts in last 15m about hallucinations / truncated responses. Both on EU region. They're sensitive enterprise customers.
Priya (Solutions): ok prioritize: 1) immediate mitigation (fallback/pin), 2) status page draft, 3) customer templates + PM contact.
Maya (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) route traffic off the canary variant to stable (route policy -> stable), 2) pin affected customers to stable model, 3) if routing fails, scale up stable pool. Executing step 1 now.
Alex (oncall): step 1 done — canary -> stable. Starting customer pin sweep for sessions hitting the failing model.
incident-bot: Action logged: reroute executed by Alex at 2173456798.
Maya (SRE): quick checklist for handoff: `a) rollback canary, b) pin flagged customers, c) create status page update, d) monitor quality metrics (regression-rate, infer-latency), e) postmortem owner`
Lina (Product): Draft status page (short):
statusbot: DRAFT STATUS:
  - Summary: We observed a model quality regression affecting a subset of Gen-Chat requests in EU.
  - Impact: Some customers saw truncated or lower-quality responses (estimated <5% of requests).
  - Mitigation: Traffic routed to the stable model variant; affected customers pinned. Ongoing monitoring.
  - Next update: in 30 minutes or on new findings.
Jared (Support): Customer notification template (short):
  "Hi [Customer],
  We detected an intermittent quality regression impacting a small portion of requests in EU. We've routed traffic to a stable model and pinned your account to prevent further disruption. We're monitoring and will follow up with timeline and root cause. Apologies for the disruption. - Redwood Inference Support"
Priya (Solutions): Add PS: "If you'd like a rollback to previous model version or additional retries while we investigate, reply and we'll prioritize."
Alex (oncall): pinned 3 enterprise accounts (ids: acct-142, acct-558, acct-902) at 2173456805.
Maya (SRE): Monitoring shows error rate dropping to baseline after routing. `regression_rate` from 3.2% -> 0.4% over 4m.
Lina (Product): Product note: start immediate evals on the canary prompts to reproduce. Assigning to @Priya post-incident for repro set.
Alex (oncall): creating short handoff for next oncall (M — 1hr): current status stable, pins in place, monitoring at normal, awaiting logs from model-owner for root cause.
Priya (Solutions): I'll collate customer repros and send to model team.
Maya (SRE): docs for runbook update: add a quick command snippet to reroute: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/inference/reroute -d '{"from":"canary-x","to":"stable-x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'```
Alex (oncall): Handoff checklist posted. Please escalate if we see >1% regression again.
Lina (Product): Assign postmortem owner: Priya. I'll draft external note template after root cause. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated" at 2173456868 — monitoring for regressions.
Alex (oncall): Thanks everyone. handing off to Maya for monitoring, Priya for root-cause.
Maya (SRE): I'll keep a 30m watch and update if anything flares.
Priya (Solutions): capturing timeline + customer comms, will open postmortem ticket and link.
Jared (Support): I'll follow up with the 2 customers who reported issues, send the template with specifics.
Lina (Product): Note to team: consider adding canary-version compatibility checks to deploy pipeline (kv-cache schema checks).
Alex (oncall): closing thread for active paging; reopen if new alerts. :eyes:
